hook.text: The average hotel guest generates 1 kg of waste per night. Zero-waste hotels aim to send nothing to landfill.

buildup.text: Strategies include eliminating single-use plastics, composting food waste, and using refillable dispensers.

discovery.text: Six Senses resorts achieved 80%+ waste diversion through on-site composting, recycling, and banning plastic bottles.

twist.text: True zero waste is nearly impossible. Even the best hotels produce some unavoidable waste from packaging and repairs.

climax.text: The goal isn't perfection—it's dramatic reduction. Every kilogram diverted from landfill matters at hotel scale.

punchline.text: Zero waste is a direction, not a destination. Progress beats perfection.

quiz.question: What waste diversion rate have Six Senses resorts achieved?
